details.completeness_justification: K1, K2, K5, K6, K7, and K8 are all adequately represented in the candidate summary with sufficient core meaning coverage. K3 and K4 are missing entirely—no mention of the Rūdnikai defence campus contracts or the Krulli/Uus-Karlowa real estate PPP agreements. This represents two HIGH-importance items that change the overall strategic picture, but the remaining six HIGH items are well-covered, justifying a 'Generally yes' score.
details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. All statements are logically connected and support each other without contradictions. The summary follows a clear structure: overview of performance drivers (S1), consolidated financial results (S2-S7), segment performance (S9-S10, S14-S15), investment activity (S16-S17), cash flow and balance sheet (S19-S20), and dividend proposal (S21). Explanations for margin changes are consistent (S4, S7, S15). While there is a decline in both revenue and profits, the reasons provided (completion of large projects, market conditions, write-downs) are consistent throughout. There is no unnecessary repetition, and all figures are presented in a way that logically supports the overall narrative of a declining but still profitable business with strategic investments.
